records.title: Samsung Galaxy S10e beyond0lte model boundary
records.summary: LineageOS maps beyond0lte to the Exynos Galaxy S10e model set SM-G970F, SM-G970F/DS, and SM-G970N. Similar S10-family names do not transfer this codename or package compatibility.
symptoms: Galaxy S10e variant needs exact identification
diagnostic_steps: Match the hardware model from Download Mode or verified Android properties against the maintained model list.
fix_steps: Select only a guide or package that explicitly includes the observed beyond0lte model number.
expected_outcomes: Galaxy S10e is separated from beyond1lte S10 and beyond2lte S10+ packages.
known_incompatibility: Snapdragon carrier variants not listed by the source
recovery_routes: Re-run Device DNA before choosing Samsung firmware or recovery

scope.scope_note: Maintainer-published alias set. Firmware region, bootloader revision, and package build still require separate proof.
